candidate_ledger.output_variable_reasoning: The nondimensional velocity u/U in the Blasius boundary layer is a function of a single similarity variable eta = y * sqrt(U/(nu * x)). Dimensional analysis with inputs U (velocity), nu (kinematic viscosity), x (length), and y (length) shows only one independent dimensionless group combining y, U, nu, and x; hence u/U depends only on that group. This yields high confidence that u/U is dimensionless and the chosen inputs are sufficient to form the similarity variable.
